messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up: we're renaming the top-level request param `model` -> `model_id` across SDKs and docs to reduce ambiguity with environment vars and console field names. This is a non-breaking ergonomic change but requires docs updates and a short SDK shim period. TL;DR: docs update 2026-05-04, SDK patches 2026-05-11 (compat shim + warnings), hard lint 2026-06-01.

rahul: what's the user-visible impact? will old requests fail?

zoe: No hard failures. For 30 days after the SDK patch, `model` will still be accepted but SDKs will emit a one-time deprecation notice and suggest `model_id`. After 2026-06-01 docs CI and examples will use `model_id` and the linter will flag `model` in new example commits. Runtime APIs remain backwards compatible for hosted customers for now.

docs-bot: Draft guideline posted: https://go.redwood/internal/model-id-migration (internal). Example canonical snippet we'll publish: ```json
{
  "model_id": "redwood/gpt-3.5x-stable",
  "input": "summarize this..."
}
```

eng-sdk: SDK plan: add a compatibility shim that maps `model` -> `model_id` and emits a single notice logged at first call per process. Also update templates and generator tooling. We'll open PRs for py/js/go today.

qa-bot: QA note: please add a regression test that sends both `model` and `model_id` to ensure parity. We will run a quick cross-SDK matrix.

support: Support needs a KB blurb and a short troubleshooting checklist. We should include steps for customers who use infra tooling that constructs requests programmatically.

mike: Any console/API naming collisions we should be aware of? Some customers already use `MODEL` env var.

zoe: Good call. We'll document env var precedence and recommend `REDWOOD_MODEL_ID` as the canonical env var going forward. We'll also add an SDK warning when both `MODEL` and `REDWOOD_MODEL_ID` are present.

rahul: timeline checklist?

zoe: Short checklist:
- Update docs examples + generate new samples (docs-bot) by 2026-05-04
- SDK minor patches with shim & notice (eng-sdk) 2026-05-11
- CI soft enforcement (lint warnings) 2026-05-20
- KB + support templates published 2026-05-21
- Hard lint and example sweep (CI fails) 2026-06-01

docs-bot: We'll add an automated migration script snippet in the guide: ```bash
rw migrate-param --from model --to model_id --dry-run
```

eng-sdk: We'll also add a small codemod for common patterns in repos and call it out in the migration guide. PR link will be in the guide.

support: Please include a short 'rollback' note saying customers can keep sending `model` indefinitely for hosted until they upgrade SDKs, but we recommend switching to `model_id` for future-proofing.

qa-bot: I'll schedule a quick smoke test run on 2026-05-12 after SDK patches land.

zoe: Owners: @docs-bot (guide + examples), @eng-sdk (patches + codemod), @qa-bot (tests), @support (KB). If blockers surface, ping me here. Thanks! :rocket:
